label: fw.wad, the mod's textures, judged as one set: a concrete wall, a wet concrete floor, a steel grate with holes, a catwalk floor, a pipe-covered wall, a hazard-striped trim, a rusted steel plate, a control panel with dials, a sodium lamp's face (lit), the water, a sign reading PUMP 3, a door

halfLifeDetail.band: T5's band is least to most, Half-Life's own from the 5th to the 95th in 100: fine detail inside it is Valve's own range (a quartile is no bound); under least reads smeared or flat, over most noisy. A texture the brief asks to be one plain colour is flat in Valve's too (its BLACK and YELLOW are 0): flat is right there, and T5 is 2

T1.reason: Most textures read as their material: fw_concrete (grey mottled), fw_wetfloor (grey-green), fw_hazard (yellow and black diagonal stripes), fw_pump3 (yellow with black 'PUMP 3' lettering), fw_door (green panelled door), fw_tile and fw_catwalk (grey plates). Three fall short. fw_pipes shows one horizontal pipe with rivets, not a pipe-covered wall. fw_panel is a dark screen with two orange discs and no switches or row of dials, so it reads only weakly as a control panel. fw_rust is tan and brown, reading more like wood panelling than rusted steel.

T2.reason: Colours match the brief's palette: grey concrete, grey-green wet floor, yellow hazard and pump sign, sodium orange lamp, green-grey water, dark green door and a steel grate in light grey. Nothing reads as neon or sci-fi. The colour check against the brief's words passes for each texture.

T3.reason: Panel and seam scale look plausible for a game wall: fw_tile and fw_catwalk have a grid of about 4 by 4 plates per 128 units, fw_pipes a rivet pattern on 256, fw_grate a regular 64-pixel bar-and-hole pattern, fw_door two raised panels per leaf. Nothing is out of proportion to a wall of Half-Life's.

T4.reason: No seam is visible at the edges of fw_concrete, fw_wetfloor, fw_water, fw_rust, fw_tile, fw_catwalk or fw_hazard in the flat view. The repeat steps are no larger than the texture's own variation. fw_pipes and fw_door show their panel lines as part of the design, not as repeat seams.

T5.reason: Two textures sit below Half-Life's band, which runs from 10.8 to 75 of fine detail. fw_water measures 3.1 and reads smeared and flat, showing only faint vertical streaks. fw_door measures 6.6 and its wood grain is soft. fw_hazard measures 96.6, above the band, and is noisy at the pixel level. fw_grate is bright and flat-looking next to Valve's grates. The rest sit inside the band (fw_concrete 22.7, fw_pipes 23.2, fw_panel 19.7) and look believable.

T6.reason: Names and sizes follow the brief: fw_concrete 256, fw_wetfloor 256, {fw_grate 64, fw_catwalk 128, fw_pipes 256, fw_hazard 64, fw_rust 128, fw_panel 128, ~fw_lamp 128, !fw_water 128, fw_pump3 128x64, fw_door 128x256, fw_tile 128. The '{' grate shows dark gaps where the holes are. The '!' water is a liquid texture. The lamp face is lit, bright at its centre with an orange frame. There are no animation frames to check.
